question: List the names of business customers in Chicago.
gold_sql: SELECT full_name FROM customers WHERE segment = 'business' AND city = 'Chicago'

question: Show the order IDs of cancelled orders placed in 2026.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2027-01-01'

question: How many failed payments were made by UPI?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed_upi_payments FROM payments WHERE status = 'failed' AND method = 'upi'

question: What is the average unit price of products in the Audio category?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.unit_price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Audio'

question: What are the total shipping fees collected from orders that were not cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(shipping_fee), 2) AS shipping_total FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled'

question: How many cancelled orders used each payment method?
gold_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY payment_method

question: What is the average rating across all reviews?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM reviews

question: What is the total refund amount for returns with reason damaged?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) AS damaged_refunds FROM returns WHERE reason = 'damaged'

question: Which brand earned the most revenue from delivered orders?
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which carriers have delivered orders shipped to Seattle?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.carrier FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE o.shipping_city = 'Seattle' AND s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL

question: How many distinct customers have returned at least one item?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id

question: How many orders were placed in March 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) = '2026-03'

question: What was the revenue in the first quarter of 2026, leaving out cancelled orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS q1_revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-04-01' AND status <> 'cancelled'

question: On average, how many days pass between an order date and its shipment date?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.shipped_at) - julianday(o.order_date)), 2) AS avg_days FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id

question: How many orders were placed between 1 and 7 January 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-01-07'

question: How many customers are based in Denver?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers WHERE city = 'Denver'

question: How many delivered orders went to Denver?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE shipping_city = 'Denver' AND status = 'delivered'

question: Which customers have placed at least 8 orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.full_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 8

question: Which product categories have an average review rating below 3?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN reviews r ON r.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING AVG(r.rating) < 3 ORDER BY avg_rating

question: How many distinct products carry the bestseller tag?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.product_id) AS products FROM product_tags pt JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id WHERE t.name = 'bestseller'

question: Which tags appear on products in the Fiction category?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.name FROM tags t JOIN product_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pt.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Fiction'

question: What percentage of delivered orders were paid by card?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN payment_method = 'card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS card_pct FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'

question: Which 3 shipping states have the highest average order value, leaving out cancelled orders?
gold_sql: SELECT shipping_state, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY shipping_state ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 3
